leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct controlled form components with state management for input fields
Implement form validation logic using conditional rendering and error states
Configure event handlers to capture and process user input data
Apply validation rules to restrict invalid form submissions
Bind form field values to component state using controlled inputs
Render dynamic error messages based on validation results
Integrate form submission workflows with data processing functions
Manipulate form state to reset fields after successful submission
